# Omni Projects Pvt. Ltd.

> Omni Projects Pvt. Ltd. (OPPL) is a Hyderabad-based renewable energy and solar EPC (engineering, procurement and construction) company. It delivers 3MW–100MW utility-scale and C&I rooftop solar power plants, balance of system and power evacuation, 33kV–220kV substations, battery energy storage (BESS) integration, operations and maintenance (O&M), and open-access project development across 12 Indian states, with a 350 MW+ portfolio commissioned and ongoing.

## Key facts

- Headquarters: Building Number 9, Mindspace, HITEC City, Hyderabad, Telangana 500081, India
- Phone: +91-9500063064
- Email: Contact@omnifincon.co.in
- Website: https://omniprojects.co.in/
- Portfolio: 350 MW+ solar capacity, commissioned and ongoing
- Footprint: execution teams active in 12 Indian states; projects in Tamil Nadu, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Andhra Pradesh and Odisha
- Team: 200+ technical professionals; 4 design branches
- Structure: joint venture with Jayram Industries India Pvt. Ltd., combining financial expertise (15+ years of financial advisory, ₹20,000 Cr+ disbursements) with engineering capability

## Services

- Solar EPC (3MW–100MW): turnkey engineering, C&I rooftop and commissioning
- Balance of System & Evacuation: civil and electrical BoS, grid interface lines
- 33kV–220kV Substations: switchyards, HT systems, STU coordination
- BESS Integration: storage integration for grid resilience; small-scale BESS manufacturing
- O&M & Asset Support: monitoring, performance analysis, optimization
- Central and State EPC Tenders, Open Access Land: OHE execution and approvals coordination

## EPC workflow

Capital (financial modelling, debt syndication) → Land (aggregation, open-access clearances) → Engineering (design optimisation) → EPC (procurement, civil works, synchronisation) → O&M (preventive maintenance, asset reporting)

## Clients

NTPC Limited, NTPC Renewables, NLC India, SCCL, BHEL, NCC Limited, LANCO, Airports Authority of India, South Central Railway, juwi
